title: Ceiling-first full-stack training-free numerical world model: highest reliable scale and backoff
developer_disclosure: Local DEV prototype source was constructed and smoke-tested before this preregistration; no PRIMARY world/score was executed. Therefore DEV numbers are exploratory. All PRIMARY seeds, thresholds and cohorts are frozen by this committed prereg prior to PRIMARY.
objective: Implement a complete bounded training-free numerical relation model with memory, multi-hop inference, intervention, repair, cold restore and unseen query compositions. Attempt max preregistered scale first, back off through fixed sizes, preserve resource and negative results, and compare a strong sparse Python symbolic oracle. Explicitly separate specified algorithm compilation from autonomous knowledge discovery.
hypotheses: With complete, explicit graph observations and supplied numerical interpreter, composed answers at all executed sizes remain exact without gradient fitting.
The general-purpose interpreter can reuse acquired numerical graph weights for new compositions after cold restore and local edge intervention.
Upper scale eventually becomes cost- or memory-noncompetitive with a sparse symbolic graph representation; determine the largest scale satisfying a prespecified latency criterion.
Withheld true edges cannot be perfectly recovered from incomplete observations alone; demonstrate this negative without target-label leakage.

fixed_design.budget_rule: Screen levels whose 8*N*N/8 dense-bit bytes exceed budget before attempting. Mark RESOURCE_SCREENED_NOT_EXECUTED; never call this a model failure.
fixed_design.source_generator: SHA256('WSP38-EDGE-V1|world|N|rel|entity|counter') first 8 bytes modulo N, deterministically filling 3 unique edges for each row
fixed_design.heldout_graph_source: SHA256('WSP38-WITHHOLD|world|N|rel|source|target') modulo 2; remove roughly half of true edges from learner observations only
fixed_design.source_scope: Synthetic seeded public directed multi-relation graph; no hidden-source labels sent to model; no natural text, knowledge base from a corpus, or real environment is provided.
fixed_design.prompt_free_query_type: (source integer, ordered relation sequence of length 1–6, target integer)
fixed_design.novel_queries: Independent deterministic query seed world+500, not passed to model during construction.
fixed_design.fidelity_metric: All evaluated answers must match independent Python set-based graph walk on complete source records.
fixed_design.cold: Snapshot complete numeric state, validate SHA256 and exact canonical re-encoding.
fixed_design.repair: Remove one observed relation edge; require changed factual answer, exactly one fewer edge, and unaffected relation rows unchanged with cold replay.
fixed_design.negative: Half-withheld observations must fail to recover at least one true edge; report number missing without inventing a guess.
baselines: Python set-based sparse graph traversal with identical complete information and query set
fixed_design.trained_baseline: Not feasible in this bounded experiment; do not claim superiority over fully trained conventional neural learners or all-in training replacement.

thresholds.engineering: Every executed scale: zero mismatched complete-information answers, 24/24 novel compositions, cold exact parity, successful isolated repair, half-withheld known-edge failures, corruption rejection, regression passes on Windows and Linux.
thresholds.primary_success: Both platforms complete all primary worlds and provide source/tree receipts, deterministic correctness digests, and full legacy regressions.
thresholds.resource_exclusion: Never classify a prescreened memory level as a computational or scientific failure.
thresholds.sweetspot: Largest executed scale that scores 100% and has aggregate numeric query time <=2.0 times Python sparse oracle across 3 primary worlds on each platform; report per-platform winners separately and only claim shared winner if same. Timing is implementation and hardware dependent.
thresholds.scientific_classification: BOUNDARY_MEASURED when qualified. SCIENTIFIC_NEGATIVE for claims of superior model intelligence: identical known-data answers cannot show independent knowledge discovery. INVALID if leakage, missing controls, unqualified source, unplanned tuning or drifting primary.
